name: fade_render_channel_in

stack.evidence: func_001DB118 passes the earlier stack value as the render-channel index and the top value as the duration to func_001084F0, then decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: func_001084F0 indexes the same 32 transition records as command 542, initializes the selected record's countdown to twice the supplied duration, its blend weight to 0.0, and its per-tick delta to +1/(2*duration). func_00108548 increases the blend weight to one and sets the corresponding D_002B91E8 channel bit when the transition completes. All 20 JP calls are in copies of the same ew31.ard event; channels 1, 3, 5, and 7 alternate with command 542's even channels during the effect.
